description: Retrying the same public search with the same MCP request identity replays the same bounded operation. Paid context routing for useful work. Route a question across policy-eligible Tier 1 context available to the account, including private, shared, licensed, or public catalogs when present. Returns up to ten verified excerpts, exact source coordinates, signed result ids, and reference URLs. Broad questions may need focused follow-up searches; absence from one result set does not establish absence from the corpus. Authentication and an active paid plan are required. This is not an unrestricted web crawler and cannot change files.

profile.description: Optional keyed profile for this search, derived locally by the agent from the account key (profile_from_key_hex) and sent per request. The profile is key-equivalent: it is never stored or logged — only its fingerprint travels onward. Omit for the unkeyed namespace.

query.description: The natural-language question to route across policy-eligible Tier 1 context. Eligible context may include private, shared, licensed, or public catalogs available to the paid account.

name: search
title: Route Tier 1 context
